description: This Java class defines the ShareAccountChargePaidBy entity, representing a record of a charge paid by a share account transaction in the Fineract system. It maps to the database table 'm_share_account_charge_paid_by' and includes references to related transaction and charge entities, as well as the amount paid.

classes.name: ShareAccountChargePaidBy
classes.description: Entity representing the payment of a share account charge, linked to a transaction and charge, with amount details.

methods.name: ShareAccountChargePaidBy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the entity with transaction, charge, and amount.

methods.name: getCharge
methods.description: Returns the associated share account charge.

methods.name: getShareAccountTransaction
methods.description: Returns the associated share account transaction.

methods.name: getChargeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the charge.

methods.name: getShareChargeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the share account charge.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the transaction and charge references to null.
